misclassified_entities.reason: Internal state storage, not an external entity - block hashes are retrieved from internal chain state

trusted_external_entities.name: Mining Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External mining software connecting over TCP. No authentication required for connection. Submits arbitrary data including worker credentials and solutions.

trusted_external_entities.name: Mining Pool Server
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Network peer distributing work. Could be MITM attacker impersonating pool. Sends job data, epoch, target difficulty without cryptographic attestation.

trusted_external_entities.name: Protocol Participant
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Generic client/server sending Stratum protocol messages. No authentication required, messages must be fully validated for JSON format, hex encoding, and message type.

trusted_external_entities.name: Decentralized Application
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Web application requesting Ethereum account access. Runs in browser context, could be malicious. Must never receive accounts without explicit user consent.

trusted_external_entities.name: Browser User
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Human user granting or denying account access via browser UI. User consent is authoritative for permission decisions, but user may not understand security implications.

trusted_external_entities.name: Executing Smart Contract
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Contract code invoking EVM opcodes. External code may attempt gas manipulation via access list timing, information leakage via balance queries, or memory/stack exploits.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Submitter
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Entity submitting signed transactions. Could be legitimate EOA or attacker attempting address collision attack. Transaction must be fully validated including sender CodeHash check.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P network peer propagating blocks. May propagate blocks containing invalid transactions from contract addresses. All block transactions must be validated.

trusted_external_entities.name: Address Collision Attacker
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Sophisticated attacker with significant compute resources. May have invested ~$10B to find address collision. EIP-3607 check is last line of defense.

trusted_external_entities.name: RPC Client
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Application using eth_call or eth_estimateGas. May attempt to simulate transactions with arbitrary sender addresses. Simulation does not bypass EIP-3607 for real transactions.

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Producer
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Validator producing blocks. Authenticated via consensus mechanism but can manipulate some block context values within protocol bounds (timestamp manipulation, MEV).

boundary_edges.security_assumption: TCP connection must be followed by full protocol handshake. No data trusted until session established.
Session ID must be validated against cache. Expired sessions require full re-authorization.
Mining configuration must be validated for format. Client may choose to verify epoch against local chain state.
Job data must be validated for format. Miner assumes pool provides legitimate work.
Full JSON message validation required: format, type, hex encoding, worker tokens, job IDs.
DApp runs in sandboxed browser context. Provider existence check is informational only.
Request must trigger user consent dialog. Accounts never exposed without explicit approval.
Browser must correctly isolate consent dialog from DApp manipulation. User decision is authoritative.
Access list warming must be enforced. Cold access charged 2600 gas, warm access 100 gas.
Full transaction validation required: nonce, signature, sender CodeHash (EIP-3607).
All transactions in block must pass EIP-3607 validation. Block rejected if any tx sender has code.
EIP-3607 CodeHash check must block transactions from addresses with deployed code, preventing collision attacks.
Simulation mode bypass only applies to eth_call/eth_estimateGas. Real transactions must enforce EIP-3607.

data_flows_across: Block context values (coinbase, timestamp, number, prevrandao, gaslimit, chainid)
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Block context set by validator, verified by consensus. Values within protocol bounds but may be manipulated within allowed ranges.
